era: 2019 reuters.com as every visitor saw it for most of the year (Arquivo.pt captures 2019-03 and 2019-06 agree): dark grey #333/#404040 header with the orange-dot REUTERS logo centred over 'Edition: United States', a nav row Business / Markets / World / Politics / Tech / Breakingviews / Wealth / Life / Pictures / Video with a search icon, THE WIRE column, orange EXCLUSIVE labels and bullets, MARKETS box with Stocks/Bonds/Currencies/Commodities tabs, uppercase section headings with a rule, serif article body with a '1 MIN READ' line and Twitter/Facebook share buttons. In December 2019 article pages moved to a white header (art-a201912); the theme keeps the design most of 2019 showed. There were no sign-in, save, text-size or WhatsApp features in 2019.

sources.shows: home: dark header, Edition: United States, nav Business/Markets/World/Politics/Tech/Breakingviews/Wealth/Life/Pictures/Video, search icon, THE WIRE, hero with EXCLUSIVE label and orange bullets, MARKETS box with Stocks/Bonds/Currencies/Commodities, SPONSORED CONTENT, FEATURED, full section menu (Business, Markets, World, Politics, Tech, Breakingviews, Wealth, Life, Pictures, Video) and edition list

home: same dark header and nav with home, camera and video icons and search, THE WIRE with time-ago lines, hero 'Mexico urges Trump to back down on unfair tariff threat' with orange bullets, MARKETS box with S&P/Dow/Nasdaq/FTSE 100/Nikkei 225, SPONSORED CONTENT

article: section kicker and dateline in small caps, large headline, '1 MIN READ', Twitter and Facebook share buttons, serif body, 'Reporting by ...', 'Our Standards: The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles', TRENDING; footer Apps, Newsletters, Advertise with Us, Advertising Guidelines, Cookies, Terms of Use, Privacy, social twitter/facebook/youtube/instagram/linkedin, '© 2019 Reuters. All Rights Reserved.'; top strip Discover Thomson Reuters, Directory of sites, Login, Contact, Support
article page as served in 2019-10: headline, byline, share buttons, serif body, footer links
article page as served in 2019-12: kicker, dateline, headline, MIN READ, share buttons, serif body, Our Standards line

stock photos of reuters.com on a screen (Google Images, 'reuters.com website 2019'): dark header with the orange-dot REUTERS logo and the nav row World / Tech / Breakingviews / Life
